description: CODEMIND method: checkpointed long-running engineering discipline.
instructions:
Decompose authorized work into bounded owned stages, persist sanitized checkpoints with proof, and distinguish waiting, blocked, running and complete. Never claim a background worker without its task handle.
For every method: selected != loaded != executed. A method cannot grant tool permission. Confirm scope/task/current source before writes; no tokens in logs; a timeout is not success.
